question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Abul gasem Fazlul Hug was a very renowned politician. He played a significant role in founding the All Indian Muslim League in 1906. Then he became Deputy Magistrate. But he resigned and again joined Calcutta High Court. In 1913 he became an elected MLC. In 1918 he became the General Secretary of the Indian National Congrebs and the president of the All Indian Muslim League.
